project.name: AgentAlgo
project.idea: A 12-agent AI trading desk in the browser, built for Indian F&O: analysts debate, bull vs bear researchers argue, a risk team stress-tests, a portfolio manager decides — and you get one Trade Card (what to buy, entry, stop loss, targets, lots). Research tool only; never places broker orders.
project.tags: fintech, ai-agents, trading, langgraph, india, f&o

phases.summary: Vision: bring the TradingAgents (TauricResearch, LangGraph) multi-agent engine to the browser as a multi-user SaaS; positioning = research & decision-support, not advice, no order execution.

Stack: FastAPI + Python 3.12 backend consuming TradingAgents as a library; React 18 + TypeScript + Vite frontend; Docker Compose; GitHub Actions CI. BYO LLM/data keys → ₹0 platform API cost; Cowork bridge runs the engine on the Claude subscription.

PRD v1.0 (2026-09-03): feature-parity contract F# table mapping every repo capability to a web feature; personas Ravi / Elena / Marcus; goals G1–G5; non-goals (no brokerage, no billing, no native apps).

Architecture: engine graph → analysts → bull/bear → research manager → trader → risk debate → portfolio manager; per-user encrypted keys; decision log with pending→resolved lifecycle + reflections; FTS research library; background loops (queue pump, triggers, schedules, alerts).

Built Phases 2–4 of the PRD: HITL pauses, alerts, paper trading, ensembles, triggers, Agent Studio, research library; then the F&O Desk (live NSE option chain, Greeks, delta-targeted strikes, Trade Card, Level Watch) and Scalp Mode + Pine mirror.
Quality round 3 (2026-09-04): 14 findings incl. 3 High (ensemble 500, HITL wedge after restart, stored XSS) all fixed same day; 58/58 then; README badge now 88 tests passing.
Docker Compose + CI in place; running locally via backend/run_dev.sh with auto-restart supervisor. Paper-month trial live against Kite quotes (30-day gate before any real-money decision).

A.programming_language: Python 3.12 / FastAPI backend (TradingAgents LangGraph engine as a library); React 18 + TypeScript + Vite frontend; SQLite/FTS; Docker Compose
A.original_requirements: Bring the full TradingAgents multi-agent research pipeline to the browser as a multi-user SaaS with BYO API keys, live agent observability and a persistent decision memory — then specialise it for Indian F&O with a single Trade Card.
A.product_goals:
Full feature parity with the TradingAgents CLI from the web UI (G1)
Multi-user SaaS with isolated data and per-user encrypted keys (G2)
Live observability of every agent, message, tool call and report section (G3)
A.user_stories:
As Ravi (retail researcher), I want a decision plus the reasoning trail for 2–5 tickers a week using one LLM key
As Elena (quant hobbyist), I want to compare providers/models and debate depths and export reports with token cost visible
As Marcus (finance lead), I want the team's watchlist run on a schedule and the decision log's accuracy reviewed over time
As an Indian F&O trader, I want one Trade Card: trigger, premium to buy, entry, SL, T1/T2, R:R and lots sized from my capital
A.competitive_analysis:
TradingAgents CLI (upstream): full engine, Python-only, single user
One-prompt LLM chat: one opinion, no debate, no memory
Broker research tabs: data-rich, no multi-agent reasoning, no decision grading
Paid signal services: opaque, no reasoning trail, often no risk sizing

quadrantChart
  title Reasoning depth vs Accessibility
  x-axis CLI / experts only --> Browser, anyone
  y-axis One opinion --> Multi-agent debate + memory
  "TradingAgents CLI": [0.15, 0.9]
  "LLM chat": [0.9, 0.2]
  "Broker research": [0.7, 0.3]
  "Our Target Product": [0.85, 0.9]
A.requirement_analysis: Hard parts: (1) streaming the LangGraph run state to the browser without touching engine core logic; (2) per-user encrypted BYO keys across ~20 LLM providers; (3) decision log lifecycle pending→resolved with realised return and alpha; (4) NSE option-chain data + Greeks with point-in-time protection; (5) honest paper trading against live Kite quotes before any money is at risk. Reliability risk shown by the 5→17 Sep silent skip of scheduled runs.

A.ui_design_draft: Guided run configurator (ticker, date, analyst team, provider/model, debate depth) → live agent board (status, messages, tool calls, report sections streaming) → structured reports + Trade Card → Decision Log and Desk Review. F&O Desk page with option chain, Greeks ladder, Level Watch; Paper Trade page with live portfolio and manual Exit; Agent Studio; Research library with FTS.
A.anything_unclear: Test count: README badge says 88 passing; QUALITY_REPORT round 3 says 58/58 — cite the CI run, not a fixed number. Deployment: Docker Compose exists but day-to-day runs via run_dev.sh with a supervisor → deployStatus = staging.

B.implementation_approach: FastAPI service wraps the TradingAgents engine as a library (no core changes; service-hardening only). Background loops: queue pump, trigger sweep, schedule sweep, alert dispatcher, paper monitor (10 s poll). SQLite with FTS for the research library. React/Vite SPA consumes REST + streaming endpoints. A Cowork bridge (bridge/cowork_bridge.py) lets the engine run on the Claude subscription at ₹0 API cost. Pine Script mirrors the scalp rules for chart review.

C.shared_knowledge: Research tool only — never places broker orders; carry the upstream disclaimer everywhere. BYO keys; no platform-provided keys. Sizing unified at ₹1L @ 7.5% across signals, scoreboard and paper desk (user decision 8b22be3). Theta cutoff 15:00 (paper-month trial). Paper monitor polls every 10 s. Never present a stale quote as live — at-trigger estimates are labelled.
